verdict.rationale: New Relic ships an official, actively documented CLI (newrelic-cli) with concrete capabilities like entity search, tagging, workload definitions, and deployment markers, plus a separate nrdiag diagnostics CLI, confirmed both in GitHub repo and docs/tutorial pages. This is a general-purpose CLI rather than one purpose-built for AI-native/agentic workflows specifically. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-native features within the CLI itself (e.g., natural-language or agent-oriented commands) and independent hands-on validation of the CLI's usability.
